_about: The events (src/delivery/events.js; the plan: EVENTS-NOTES.md). events: the one-level events (the menu's Events group): an entry is a level's id, or { id, from, to, reward } (from / to: "2026-12-01" is midnight on the player's device, or a time with its zone; reward: { car, money, id }, given once). special: the special events, a series of stages played in turn: { id, name, short, from, to, prize: { car }, stages: [ { level, from, car, free, clock: { good, evil }, ... } ] }. A stage plays its level's map as a level of its own (id <event>-<n>); car: the car it needs (owned), or with free: true the car it lends (a free try); clock: written out in full for the stage (never a share of the map's); any other field of a level overrides the map's. Check: node scripts/events.mjs check.
